channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Landscaper enters Ormond Beach mayoral race
item.description: Damien Curry, owner of Garden Boys Landscaping, filed to run for the open seat on Feb. 13.

item.title: Motive adds Beacon tracking device for small equipment
item.description: Motive Beacon is powered by the Motive Mesh Network, the company’s network that uses Motive Vehicle Gateways and devices running the Motive Fleet App and Driver App.

item.title: Davey Tree names Schoenberger as president of tree surgery company
item.description: The company also promoted James Doyle to president of Davey Tree Canada and Brent Repenning to president of specialized services and emerging businesses.

item.title: Kubota introduces SVL110-3 compact track loader
item.description: The SVL110-3's defining trait is Kubota's proprietary Auxiliary Performance System, a software-driven system engineered to reduce and eliminate machine stalling.

item.title: KeyServ appoints 4 new leaders across company
item.description: KeyServ names Taylor Kelly and Jacob Lachapelle as vice presidents, while KeyServ companies Trim All Lawn Service and Quality Creative Landscaping appointed new execs.

item.title: Wilson360 names Anderson as featured speaker for Thought Leaders Retreat 2026
item.description: David Anderson, global leadership speaker and author of Leader Is Not a Title, will also lead an optional pre-event half-day session on July 27 limited to 35 attendees.

item.title: Bobcat rolls out new compact loader lineup
item.description: Bobcat has realigned its lineup into two distinct compact loader categories: Classic and Pro.

item.title: Makita debuts 40V max XGT Brushless 20-inch chain saw
item.description: The GCU08 is Makita’s most powerful cordless chainsaw.

item.title: Greenworks supplies World Ice Art team with contest's first battery-powered tools
item.description: The Multi Block Competition challenges teams of four artists to transform nine massive blocks of ice into monumental sculptures over six days.

item.title: Loftness names McComas as chief operating officer
item.description: Since joining Loftness in 2024, Shannon McComas most recently served as vice president of sales & marketing.
